snippet.title: Sword Hero Gameplay Trailer | Play Demo Now | A deeply reactive Open World RPG, inspired by classics
snippet.description:
🎮 Play the free demo today on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739080/Sword_Hero/

Discover Sword Hero, a deeply reactive open world RPG inspired by Gothic, Kenshi, Berserk, and other classics.
Forge your own path through a dangerous medieval world, join powerful factions, and face monsters that don’t scale down to your level.

🎮 Play the Free Demo Today on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739080/Sword_Hero/

⚔️ About the Demo:
This demo isn’t a direct slice of the main game. Instead, we’ve built a dedicated Combat Arena, where you can test your skills in battle. Survive through waves of enemies, each round demanding different strategies and approaches.
The full game will be a vast open world RPG — but for now, the demo is all about Arena fights.

💬 Have questions about the game or demo? Drop them in the comments — we’re happy to clarify!

Wishlist Sword Hero on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739080/Sword_Hero/

Launching soon on Kickstarter, be amongst the first to try the game, get notified on launch here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itspossible/sword-hero

#rpggames #indiegame #gaming
